items.title: 3 Pharma Stocks That Could Benefit From Sanofi’s Insmed Deal
items.summary: Sanofi’s US$41b move for lung disease specialist Insmed has put pharma deal making firmly back on the radar, and investors do not want to be the last to notice where the next late stage pipelines might sit. Big cheques and a 17% premium can reset expectations across the sector, which creates both opportunity and risk. This article walks through 3 stocks that appear most exposed to this Sanofi catalyst right now. The three stocks below are only a starting sample, since the full screen surfaced...
